design.severity: All 217 QC>=200 acute blood draws paired with contemporaneous same-day WHO severity (WHO_temp_severity 0-3, 0 missing); within-source draw-level rank-INT; patient-clustered Exchangeable GEE (+weeks) with Huber-White and Mancl-DeRouen bias-reduced SE + Mundlak within-vs-between decomposition + cluster-bootstrap Spearman.
design.mortality: One baseline observation per patient: Donor FIRST blood draw paired with forensically verified death (TRUE_PUB_11; N=66, 11 deaths; Real n=37/5d, PBISC new n=29/6d); exact Mann-Whitney AUC/P + same-day WHO adjustment + <=7d (n=53/10d) + Direct-9 + WHO 2-3.
design.fatal_draw_count_asymmetry: Real 5 deaths = 20 draws (4.0/pt) vs PBISC new 6 deaths = 8 draws (1.3/pt; 4/6 single draw)
